summary: US tariffs on Chinese goods changed again: IEEPA duties were struck down in Feb 2026 and the 10% Section 122 surcharge lapsed July 24, 2026, but a new 12.5% Section 301 'forced-labor' duty now stacks on the 7.5%/25% legacy Section 301 lists plus MFN, so most China-sourced goods land around 20% to 40%+ (toys about 20%, apparel about 36.5%, general electronics and housewares about 37.5% to 40%). Amazon's January 2026 FBA fee increase and the April 2026 3.5% fuel surcharge raised fulfillment costs a little. Demand data (ASINSIGHT, July-Aug 2026) shows steady or rising sales in shower filters, scalp and hair care, cat fountains, magnetic tiles and water flossers, while pickleball paddles, weighted blankets, lip products and magnesium gummies fell sharply month over month.
changes_vs_last_run: All 7 products from the 2026-10-22 run are kept and re-costed with the new duty stack. The yoga mat price is cut from $45 to $32 because the July 2026 top-10 sold at $19-$31; this lowers its margin and score. New entrants: heatless curl set, stainless cat water fountain, orthopedic dog bed, posture corrector, magnetic spice rack set, cordless water flosser, magnesium glycinate gummies, rosemary scalp-care kit, red light therapy wand, shiatsu neck massager, magnetic tiles, pickleball paddle set, resistance band kit, compression socks, toothpaste tablets, car trunk organizer, gua sha/ice roller kit, lip oil trio, weighted blanket, creatine gummies. Two new rejects (GLP-1 supplement, unlicensed Pokemon/World Cup merch). Trend scores rest on single-month MoM figures from ASINSIGHT, not 12-month Google Trends series, so treat them as moderate confidence. Cost, freight and CPC figures are my estimates; no live Alibaba quotes were available.

candidates.name: Hard water shower filter head, 15-stage vitamin C/KDF, with 2 spare cartridges
fixable_complaints: cartridge only lasts about a month with heavy chlorine
candidates.angle: Ship a metal-swivel head with a thread-seal gasket and 3 cartridges, and add a reorder reminder card for a 2-3 month replacement cycle.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Do not claim to treat skin conditions or remove contaminants beyond what is tested; NSF/ANSI 177 (vitamin C shower filter) is the only certification, so avoid 'certified' wording without it. If sold to Amazon, home category is open. Treat as water-treatment device marketing: no health claims. Replacement cartridges are a separate SKU for repeat sales.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: top 10 sell 5-10K units/mo at $19-$43; two listings grew 100% MoM. Leaders have 12K-69K reviews, but a $38 listing sells 7K/mo with only 933 reviews, so entry is possible. Unit cost is my estimate for a 300-500 unit order (no live Alibaba quote); duty assumes HTS 8421.21 on Section 301 List 3 (25%) + 12.5% + MFN, about 0.40; verify with a broker. Repeat orders 1.4 assumed because many buyers never reorder cartridges.

candidates.name: Premium press-on nail kit (24 nails x several sets, glue and prep kit)
candidates.angle: Include 24 true-size nails per set with a sizing guide plus strong adhesive tabs and nail glue to fix fit and lift complaints.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Nail glue and adhesives are cosmetics: MoCRA facility registration and product listing, ingredient labeling (cyanoacrylate warnings). Keep glue under allowed volume for air shipping. No drug claims.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: top 10 sell 7K-50K/mo at $7-$13; leader has 93.7K reviews. Revenue per customer is only about $36 at 2.0 orders, which is under the owner's $40 target. Alibaba seller blog quotes $5-15 per set for mass-market ABS sets at 500+ MOQ, higher than my $3.4 estimate; unit cost could be higher. Duty assumes List 4A 7.5% + 12.5%. Global market projected about 6.6% CAGR (Fortune Business Insights).

candidates.name: Pet enrichment bundle: silicone lick mat + fabric snuffle mat + slow feeder bowl
candidates.angle: Bundle three matched pieces with dishwasher-safe, stronger-suction silicone and a feeding guide, priced above the $7 single mats.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Food-contact silicone should be FDA 21 CFR 177.2600 compliant (LFGB/FDA test report from the factory) even though pet-use; no CPSIA needed. Avoid health claims ('cures anxiety').
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: top lick-mat listings $6-$17 selling 2K-7K/mo, several +50-100% MoM; best price point seen is $40.99 for a bundle-like listing selling 2K/mo. A US storefront quoted $10/unit at 500 units for custom lick mats (retail-style quote, higher than factory). My $6.00 bundle cost is an estimate. Pet feeder toys market projected 8% CAGR 2026-2034.

candidates.name: Hydrocolloid pimple patch multipack (120 patches, 3 sizes)
candidates.angle: Add a thinner edge and a mixed-size sheet with a resealable pouch; compete on pack value rather than on the brand.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Classify correctly: hydrocolloid dressings are regulated as medical devices/wound dressings (FDA); salicylic acid patches are OTC drugs. Do not claim 'treats acne' unless the product meets OTC monograph and drug listing. Check Amazon health/beauty category gating.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: Mighty Patch sells about 100K/mo with 180K+ reviews; top 10 cluster at 4.4-4.7 stars, so complaint room is small. Revenue per customer about $34 at 2.0 orders. Duty assumes HTS 3005 on List 4A + 12.5%, unverified. Low entry odds; kept for continuity with the prior run.

candidates.name: Satin sleep bonnet + silk pillowcase set
candidates.angle: Use adjustable-band 22 momme mulberry-look fabric and a matched gift box for a clear step up from $6 pillowcases.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile fiber content labeling (FTC Textile Act) and care labels; avoid 'silk' unless real silk. No other special rules.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: silk-look pillowcases dominate at $5.79-$8 with 20K-320K reviews, growth only 1-2% MoM. A $22.99 listing grew 100% but base unknown. Mature, crowded commodity. Duty mix of List 4A textiles + 12.5% + MFN (about 0.27) is an estimate.

candidates.name: Extra-thick non-slip yoga/exercise mat 6mm with strap
candidates.angle: Lead with TPE or cork-textured grip and a no-odor claim backed by test data.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Prop 65 warning review for PVC/phthalates; otherwise none beyond standard rules.
candidates.notes: Price lowered from $45 (prior run) to $32 because ASINSIGHT July 2026 shows the top 10 at $19-$31 with 1-3% MoM growth; Amazon Basics has 69.6K reviews. Duty assumes HTS 9506.91 List 3 25% + 12.5% + MFN, about 0.42; verify.

candidates.name: Microwavable weighted neck wrap + eye mask gift set
candidates.angle: Sell it as a gift set with a washable cover and unscented flax/clay fill.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile labeling; burn-risk warning label and heating instructions. No medical claims.
candidates.notes: No direct ASINSIGHT page for heat wraps; the neck-massager and weighted-blanket pages show seasonal volatility (weighted blankets down 20-55% MoM in June 2026). Trend score lowered to 4. Demand score is an estimate from adjacent categories.

candidates.name: Heatless curling set: satin rod, scrunchies and overnight cap
candidates.angle: Use a softer, thinner rod with a non-slip grip band and a shorter curl guide for fine hair.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile labeling only; hair accessories are not cosmetics.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: top 10 sell 2K-10K/mo at $5-$16, six of ten growing 50-100% MoM. Ratings only 4.0-4.4. Revenue per customer around $21, below the owner's $40 target, so only worth selling as a higher-priced bundle.

candidates.name: Stainless steel cat water fountain 2.5L, quiet pump, with spare filters
fixable_complaints: pump fails after a few months
candidates.angle: Dishwasher-safe stainless body, brushless quiet pump with a 2-year warranty, and a spare filter pack.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Electrical: UL/ETL listing for the power adapter and FCC Part 15 only if wireless; low-voltage USB pump is simpler. Pet-use water-contact materials should be food-grade stainless.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: 7 of the top 10 cluster near $20 with 3K-10K reviews to 42.8K; a $44.99 model still sells 5K/mo. Review summaries flag pump failure and noise as the top complaints. Duty assumes pumps/appliances HTS 8413.70 on List 3 + 12.5%.

candidates.name: Orthopedic calming donut dog bed, medium/large, washable cover
candidates.angle: Sell thicker high-density foam with a zip-off cover and sell spare covers as a second SKU.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile and flammability labels vary by state; California TB117-2013 labelling applies to upholstered furniture, not pet beds. Prop 65 review of foam.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: top 10 at $12-$40 selling 3K-10K/mo; four growing 100% MoM. Bedsure holds 14K-35K reviews. Bulky size means high fulfill fee ($8.90 estimate) and storage cost in Oct-Dec; margin will be thin. Duty 0.30 is a guess for HTS 9404/6307.

candidates.name: Adjustable posture corrector, sized S/M/L, breathable underarm padding
candidates.angle: Offer true size ranges with padded, soft-edge straps and a measurement chart.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Back supports can fall under FDA device rules (many are Class I, 510(k)-exempt); avoid claims like 'corrects scoliosis' or 'relieves pain'. Register and list as device if claims go beyond general wellness.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT Aug 2026: top seller 20K/mo at 3.9 stars with 46.7K reviews, so quality gaps are visible. Prices $19-$35. Revenue per customer only $30, under the owner's $40 target. Duty 0.25 is a rough guess for HTS 9021/6307.

candidates.name: Magnetic fridge spice rack with 6 labeled stainless jars
candidates.angle: Use rubber-backed strong neodymium magnets with a load rating and lids that seal.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Food-contact stainless/plastic should have FDA food-contact test reports; strong magnets are subject to air-shipping limits (DOT/IATA magnetized material) so ship by sea.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: top 10 at $10-$20, ratings 4.6-4.8, 15.5K top reviews; many are rising 25-100% MoM from small bases. Ratings are high so improvement room is modest. Duty guess: HTS 7323 List 3 + 12.5%, stainless articles may also be subject to Section 232 derivative rules (25% on derivative products) so cost could be higher.

candidates.name: Cordless rechargeable water flosser with 6 tips and travel case
candidates.angle: Offer a USB-C unit with larger reservoir, IPX7 sealing and extra tips subscription.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Water flossers are FDA Class I devices (product code JEQ): register establishment, list device, labeling rules. FCC Part 15 for charger, UL 2054 / UN38.3 for lithium battery, air shipping restrictions on batteries.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: keyword about 125K weekly searches, rank up 140 places; #8 listing at $19.99 +100% MoM. Waterpik holds 156.8K reviews, so branded competition is heavy; three listings with 8K-16K reviews sell at $20-$33. Battery adds compliance cost. Duty assumed List 3 + 12.5%.

candidates.name: Magnesium glycinate gummies, 60 count, US contract-manufactured
candidates.angle: Sell a sugar-reduced gummy with a clearly stated elemental magnesium dose and a 90-day subscription.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Dietary supplement: FDA facility registration, cGMP (21 CFR 111) via the contract manufacturer, Supplement Facts label, structure/function claims only with the DSHEA disclaimer and FDA notification within 30 days. Amazon requires third-party testing for supplements.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT June 2026: top sellers 10K-80K/mo, but every product with a trend value was down 30-50% MoM, so the trend score is set to 5 pending a longer series. Assumes US manufacturing (duty 0); if made in China add about 0.20+. Repeat 2.2 orders/yr assumes some subscribers; a 30-day supply bought twice. Unit cost is an estimate from typical gummy contract quotes.

candidates.name: Rosemary hair oil + scalp massager kit
candidates.angle: Pair a lightweight non-greasy oil with a silicone scalp brush in a gift box, selling the routine not a 'growth' promise.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic: MoCRA facility registration and product listing, safety substantiation, ingredient labeling. Do NOT claim 'regrows hair' or 'treats hair loss' (drug claim).
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: Mielle rosemary oil sold 60K/mo at $9.94 with 122K reviews and grew 100% MoM; others $10-$30 selling 6K-20K. Scalp massagers sell 4K-10K/mo at $5-$29 (one $12.99 at 2.5 stars). Customers repurchase oil, so 1.9 orders; assumes a 2-month supply. Duty: HTS 3305 List 4A + 12.5%.

candidates.name: Handheld red light therapy wand (rechargeable)
candidates.angle: Publish measured irradiance in mW/cm2 and a 1-year warranty to stand out among inflated claims.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Position as general wellness device with no medical claims; any 'treats acne/wrinkles' claim makes it a device needing FDA clearance. FCC Part 15, UL/UN38.3 lithium battery, IEC 62471 eye-safety testing recommended.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT Aug 2026: top 10 average $77, 2K-6K/mo, most down 33-67% MoM; top reviews 252-6.9K. Weak trend. Sources disagree on FDA class; going by the wellness view with the usual claim caution. Alibaba seller blog says handhelds are the fastest-growing red-light segment.

candidates.name: Shiatsu neck and back massager with heat
candidates.angle: Quieter motors, adjustable longer straps and a 2-year warranty.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Massagers are FDA Class I (exempt) if only general-wellness; do not claim to treat pain. FCC Part 15, UL listing on adapter, lithium battery rules if cordless.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: Mirakel and Nekteck each sell about 10K/mo with 33K-66K reviews. Cost assumption is mine. Heavy brand and review moat; entry will rely on paid ads.

candidates.name: Magnetic building tiles set, 60 pieces, ASTM F963-compliant
candidates.angle: Reinforced edges, fully enclosed magnets and an add-on expansion pack for repeat purchases.
candidates.regulatory_notes: CPSIA: third-party CPSC-accepted lab testing, Children's Product Certificate, tracking labels; ASTM F963 magnet requirements (magnet flux index) are mandatory; small-parts warnings. Amazon toy listings need compliance documents.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: top 10 average $45.75, 4K-10K/mo, all positive MoM (+1.5% to +60%); weekly search about 28.5K. Magna-Tiles brand has loyal customers but newer listings sit at 338-976 reviews. Duty uses the toys rate (7.5% List 4A + 12.5%) from TariffsTool.

candidates.name: Pickleball paddle set (2 paddles, 4 balls, bag), fiberglass
candidates.angle: Offer a USAPA-approved paddle set in a gift box with a better grip.
candidates.regulatory_notes: None beyond standard rules; USA Pickleball approval for tournament use.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT Aug 2026: half of the top 10 fell 40-50% MoM and weekly searches rank down 395, which may be seasonal. Treat as spike risk. Duty guess for HTS 9506.59.

candidates.name: Resistance band kit with handles, door anchor and ankle straps
candidates.angle: Latex-free fabric-wrapped bands with a workout card and a lifetime breakage guarantee.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Latex allergy labeling; Prop 65 review. None beyond standard rules.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: 'resistance bands' about 150K weekly searches (rank #294); top 3 get 46% of clicks but only 6.2% of conversions; listings at $17-$28 are growing 66-100% MoM.

candidates.name: Graduated compression socks 20-30 mmHg, 3 pairs
candidates.angle: Offer true size ranges, softer cuff and a free replacement if they lose compression.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Do not claim to treat varicose veins/DVT (medical claims). Textile and fiber-content labels; apparel return-processing fees apply on Amazon.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT Jan 2026 (older): about 73K weekly searches; leaders have 65K-211K reviews and sell $10-$29. Apparel duty uses TariffsTool's 36.5% estimate. Revenue per customer about $35 at 1.6 orders.

candidates.name: Toothpaste tablets, 3-month supply in refill pouch
candidates.angle: Use a plastic-free pouch and a subscription that lines up with the 3-month supply.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Fluoride toothpaste is an OTC drug (FDA monograph, drug listing, Drug Facts label). Fluoride-free tablets are cosmetics under MoCRA (facility registration, product listing). Do not claim to prevent cavities without fluoride.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT Mar 2026: NOBS 3-month pack at $38.24 sells about 10K/mo with 8.5K reviews, showing bundle pricing works. Assumes US contract manufacturer (duty 0); China sourcing would add about 0.2. No MoM data available.

candidates.name: Foldable car trunk organizer with cooler section
candidates.angle: Add a rigid base and non-slip bottom with a leak-proof insulated section.
candidates.regulatory_notes: None beyond standard rules.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT Mar 2026: top sellers $12-$28, up to 8K/mo, ratings 4.4-4.8. No trend data. Price too low to reach $40 per customer.

candidates.name: Stainless gua sha + ice roller + lymphatic brush facial kit in gift box
candidates.angle: Gift-ready kit with a video guide, aimed at a premium tier above $3-$10 single tools.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Mechanical tools, no FDA clearance if no claims; avoid 'lymph drainage'/'treats puffiness' claims. Gua sha cream additions are cosmetics under MoCRA.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: tools sell at $3-$10 (10K-20K/mo each); leaders in the keyword are $30 K-beauty gua sha creams (ANUA 60K/mo). Kit would be priced above the tools. Low confidence the kit price holds.

candidates.name: Lip oil trio gift set (3 tinted glossy lip oils, box)
candidates.angle: Non-sticky formula in three universal shades packaged for gifting.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic: MoCRA facility registration, product listing, ingredient labeling, color additive compliance. No drug claims.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT Aug 2026: every lip product with a trend was down (Clinique -62.5%, Laneige -85.7%). Wonderskin 3.8 and Laka 3.2 stars show quality gaps. Trend score is low as this could be seasonal or a fade.

candidates.name: Weighted blanket 15 lb with removable cover
candidates.angle: Glass-bead evenly stitched, with a cooling cover and a loop system.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile labels; do not claim to treat anxiety/insomnia; weight guidance for children (avoid for infants).
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT June 2026: 8 of 10 top listings fell 20-55% MoM; the keyword page lists non-weighted blankets, so data is noisy. Heavy item with high freight and fee. Likely thin margin.

candidates.name: Creatine monohydrate gummies, 60 count, US contract-manufactured
candidates.angle: Dose-transparent 5 g per serving with third-party lab results.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Dietary supplement rules: FDA registration, cGMP, Supplement Facts, DSHEA claims only. Amazon requires third-party testing for supplements. Check gummy creatine dose labeling; some gummies underdeliver and draw FTC/FDA attention.
candidates.notes: ASINSIGHT July 2026: gummy listings at about 10K/mo each, leader is a capsule not a gummy. Market report claims 8-10% CAGR (promotional). Unit cost is my guess; low confidence on dose economics (5 g needs a big gummy count).

candidates.name: GLP-1 'support' supplement
candidates.kill_reason: Products marketed as GLP-1 drugs or mimics cannot legally be sold as supplements; FDA treats them as unapproved drugs and sends warning letters.
candidates.angle: n/a
candidates.regulatory_notes: Rejected: a product that claims or implies GLP-1 drug effects is an unapproved drug. A plain fiber or berberine supplement with no weight-loss drug claims would be a different product.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics lists GLP-1 supplement searches +1,150% (5,920 to 74,000). Rejected on the claim risk, from my knowledge of FDA enforcement; not independently re-checked this run.

candidates.name: Unlicensed Pokemon / World Cup 2026 themed merchandise (Etsy)
candidates.kill_reason: Trademark and licence-protected brands; unlicensed goods are counterfeit/infringing and cannot be legally sold in the US.
candidates.angle: n/a
candidates.regulatory_notes: Rejected: eRank flags 'pokemon' and 'world cup 2026' as trademark-restricted search terms.
candidates.notes: Appears in rising Etsy searches (eRank June 2026) but is a brand-infringement risk.
